c_observation: In 6 of 7 multi-output cases the source or B-Rep contains recognizable physical component geometry despite one-output contract/materialization collapse. One case (container-case-002) is a genuine source omission: the required lid was not constructed.
decision_basis: 14/16 generated models are useful first concepts (CQ3 or CQ2), while all 16 remain final-blocked under strict semantic verification. This supports a distinct concept-ready lifecycle without weakening hard final verification. Two CQ1 cases show generation quality still needs independent improvement.
product_policy_observation: Current candidate policy conflates existence of a structurally valid/generated artifact with completion/certification because candidate_state is null while semantic unsupported findings block all cells. Do not change it in this audit; carry it as a separate future product-policy recovery item.
